exposure: Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Response (HOMA-IR)
cohort: 99 women admitted for preterm delivery with Hashimoto's thyroiditis and pathological HOMA-IR indices 40 days after delivery
finding: Women who underwent cesarean section had significantly higher pulsatility index and cerebroplacental ratio compared to those who delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: Cases undergoing cesarean section had significantly higher values of pulsatility index (1.85 ± 0.27 vs. 1.34 ± 0.31) and CP (1.22 ± 0.26 vs. 0.47 ± 0.17).
